name: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited condensed interim results for the six months ended 31 March 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000 to match the absolute rand columns. The issuer prints no cost of sales line, so Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are left empty rather than derived. Operating Expenses of 13454979 is the printed operating expenses 13458784 less other operating income 21765 less net insurance result 71471 plus depreciation and amortisation 88399 plus the loss on disposal of property plant and equipment 1032, so revenue less that line equals the printed operating profit before net financing costs of 700056. Net Finance Costs is finance costs 73097 less finance income 3251. Equity accounted income of 19517 sits between the finance lines and profit before tax, so operating profit less net finance costs gives 630210 and that plus 19517 gives the printed profit before tax 649727. Profit before tax less taxation of 150387 equals the printed profit for the period 499340. EPS is basic 119.5 cents converted to rand. Balance sheet ratios are left empty because a half year ratio is not comparable with the annual columns. || Yahoo Finance
